adminGroups.description:
Default authorized {@link Role}s.
Users having any of these roles can update the [AclEntries](AclEntry) for any facility.
These users' access controls to the facility are determined by seeded {@link AclPrivilege} for {@link Facility}.

additionalGroups.description:
Additional {@link Role}s.
Only {@link User}s belonging to these roles are considered as additional users in the UI.

users.description:
Any additional {@link User}s apart from users belonging to {@link FacilityAccessManager#adminGroups} that have access to a facility.
These users' access controls to the facility are determined by seeded {@link AclPrivilege} for {@link Facility}.

title: Houses all utility functions which are used to manage access controls to {@link Facility} entities.
name: FacilityAccessManager
